definitions: Devote (time, effort, or oneself) to a particular task or purpose.
Formally devote (a place or building) to a divine being or a sacred purpose.
Formally open (a new building or monument) to the public.
Inscribe or address (a book, piece of music, etc.) to someone as a mark of respect or affection.
examples: She dedicates her life to helping others.
The church was dedicated to St. Peter.
The new library will be dedicated next month.
He dedicated the book to his parents.
